product_metadata.title: AmazerBath Halloween Shower Curtain, Pumpkin Lights Party Decor Polyester Fabric Shower Curtain Bathroom Shower Curtains, Water Repellent, Hotel Quality - 72 x 72 Inches
features: Stylish design - Classic pattern and lovely color make your bathroom fabulous. Beautify your home. Brings you a brilliant home and a bright mood.

Premium quality - Made of 100% polyester fabric. Feels soft and comfortable. Water repellent. The 150 GSM (gram per square meter) shower curtain is 200g heavier than the same size 90 Gsm shower curtains of other brands.
Reinforced metal holes - 12 rust-resistant metal grommets fit most curtain hooks. The 72x72 Inches curtain fits most standard-sized bathtubs and showers.
Weighted hem - Weighted hem helps keep the curtain in place and avoids blowing, letting it hang elegantly. The sturdy hem keeps the curtain from tearing up.
Easy cleaning - Machine washable and dries quickly. Strong fabric and tight hem could avoid shrinkage and deformation. Please do not bleach it.
